title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the Ampere force as F = G tan θ.

title: Magnetic induction magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnetic field as B = (G tan θ)/(I L).

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium conditions to relate Ampere force, tension, and gravity.

title: Ampere's law application
description: Important: Uses F = BIL to relate Ampere force to magnetic field, current, and length.

title: Trigonometric resolution
description: Important: Correctly resolves forces into horizontal and vertical components using the angle θ.

title: Direction consistency
description: Optional: Notes that Ampere force direction matches magnetic field and current orientation.

title: Unit analysis
description: Optional: Includes or checks units for force (N) and magnetic field (T).

title: Incorrect force balance
description: Pitfall: Sets F = G sin θ or similar incorrect trigonometric relationship.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Uses F = BIL incorrectly (e.g., omits L or I) when solving for B.
